edits.new_string:
-- (2026-10-22 UI polish, M4) not ready = a solid silver button (the CLAIMED palette) with an INK label and no checkerboard
-- behind it; ready = lime with its checker and the white outlined label, as before
local SILVER_OFF = Color3.fromRGB(200, 205, 212)
local function setButton(color, text)
	local off = color == GREY
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = off and SILVER_OFF or color
	btnHolder.Depth.BackgroundColor3 = (off and SILVER_OFF or color):Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.4)
	local studs = btn:FindFirstChild("Studs")
	if studs then studs.Visible = not off end
	btnLabel.TextColor3 = off and B.INK or WHITE
	local ls = btnLabel:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
	if ls then ls.Enabled = not off end
	if os.clock() > flashUntil then btnLabel.Text = text end
end
